desc.id: Tiga kotak menunjukkan tiga jenis pertanyaan tentang awal mula: bagaimana hal itu terjadi, mengapa hal itu penting, dan siapa yang menceritakan kisahnya.

Faith and culture.note: The lesson uses "ajaran agama" and "kisah budaya" for faith and cultural accounts; "Agama dan budaya" is the short heading form. Worth checking with the faith reviewers of Lesson 4. | Reviewer: 'Faith' became 'Agama' (religion). This matches the L04 lesson text, so only change it course-wide; 'Kepercayaan dan budaya' is the closer, softer option on a sensitive topic.
